findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 208 requests to 50 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

17 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), criteo.com (Criteo, advertising), cxense.com (Piano (Cxense), advertising), demdex.net (Adobe, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), doubleverify.com (DoubleVerify, advertising), dv.tech (DoubleVerify, advertising), fwmrm.net (FreeWheel, advertising).
17 cookies were set by third-party domains (56 cookies in total).
